python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data for CY 1963-1977 (convertible foreign currencies in millions of dollars)
# From treasury_bulletin_1970_12_page_94.txt and treasury_bulletin_1978_12_page_91.txt
data = [212, 432, 781, 1321, 2345, 3528, 2781, 629, 276, 241, 8, 5, 80, 320, 18]

n = len(data)
mean = sum(data) / n
print(f"Years: 1963-1977 (n={n})")
print(f"Data: {data}")
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Sample standard deviation
variance = sum((x - mean)**2 for x in data) / (n - 1)
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Sample Std Dev: {std_dev}")

# Fisher-Pearson adjusted skewness
# g1 = [n/(n-1)(n-2)] * sum((xi - xbar)/s)^3
numerator_sum = sum(((x - mean) / std_dev) ** 3 for x in data)
coefficient = n / ((n - 1) * (n - 2))
skewness = coefficient * numerator_sum

print(f"Skewness (Fisher-Pearson adjusted): {skewness}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest thousandth: {round(skewness, 3)}")
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data for CY 1963-1977 (convertible foreign currencies in millions of dollars)
# From treasury_bulletin_1970_12_page_94.txt and treasury_bulletin_1978_12_page_91.txt
data = [212, 432, 781, 1321, 2345, 3528, 2781, 629, 276, 241, 8, 5, 80, 320, 18]

n = len(data)
mean = sum(data) / n
print(f"n = {n}")

# Sample standard deviation calculation
variance = sum((x - mean)**2 for x in data) / (n - 1)
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Mean = {mean}")
print(f"Sample Variance = {variance}")
print(f"Sample Std Dev = {std_dev}")

# Fisher-Pearson adjusted skewness formula
# g1 = [n / ((n-1)(n-2))] * sum((xi - xbar)/s)^3

# Calculate sum of cubed z-scores
z_scores = [(x - mean) / std_dev for x in data]
sum_cubed_z = sum(z**3 for z in z_scores)

coefficient = n / ((n - 1) * (n - 2))
skewness = coefficient * sum_cubed_z

print(f"\nFisher-Pearson Adjusted Skewness: {skewness}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(skewness, 3)}")
EOF
